ahkBridgeTitle.description: AHK bridge panel title on the options Shortcuts section.

ahkBridgeDesc.message: advanced · optional — map External hotkeys to Commands
ahkBridgeDesc.description: AHK bridge panel short description marking the feature as advanced and optional.

ahkBridgeNote.message: Record OS-level External hotkeys for Commands, then download one AHK bridge script. Rows without a Chrome target chord can still be recorded; they are skipped in the script until bound.
ahkBridgeNote.description: AHK bridge panel helper note for External hotkey recording and download.

ahkBridgeGuidance.message: Install AutoHotkey v2, download the script, then run it (optionally start with Windows). Keep each Command set to Global in Chrome shortcut settings so SendInput still reaches PlaybackKeys while another app is focused.
ahkBridgeGuidance.description: Brief AutoHotkey v2 install/run guidance plus reminder that Commands must remain Global in Chrome.

ahkClearMappings.description: Button that clears all External hotkey mappings and related AHK bridge snapshot state.

ahkClearMappingsConfirm.message: Clear all External hotkey mappings and AHK bridge download snapshot state?
ahkClearMappingsConfirm.description: Confirm dialog before clearing all AHK bridge companion storage.

ahkRecordExternal.description: Button to start External hotkey capture for a Command.

ahkClearExternal.description: Button to clear one Command External hotkey mapping.

ahkChromeTargetMissing.description: Shown when a Command has an External hotkey row but no chrome.commands shortcut yet.

ahkHighCollisionWarn.message: This External hotkey is commonly typed. While a supported browser window is usable, AutoHotkey will swallow it globally. Bind it anyway?
ahkHighCollisionWarn.description: One-shot confirm when binding a high-collision External hotkey.

ahkDownload.description: Button to download the generated AutoHotkey v2 AHK bridge script.

ahkDownloadDisabledReason.message: Need at least one External hotkey whose Command already has a Chrome target chord.
ahkDownloadDisabledReason.description: Shown beside Download when no complete External hotkey + Command chord row exists.

ahkSkipUnboundReason.description: Explains which mapped Commands are omitted from active AHK hotkey lines. $1 is a comma-separated Command list.

ahkDriftHint.message: Chrome Command chords changed since the last download. Regenerate the AHK bridge script.
ahkDriftHint.description: Dismissible hint beside Download when live chrome.commands chords drift from the last generate snapshot.

ahkDriftDismiss.description: Dismiss the AHK chord-drift regenerate hint.
